summary: Enhance your skills with our Sales Data Analytics using Power BI training course. Learn to analyze sales data effectively and drive business success.
lede: Sales data analytics using Power BI helps you turn CRM activity, transaction records, product data, and activity logs into evidence for pipeline reviews, territory planning, quota discussions, and revenue forecasting. You will learn to address inconsistent opportunity stages, duplicate accounts, missing close dates, changing product hierarchies, and differing definitions of conversion or win rate. Through practical work with Power Query, star schema design, DAX measures, and interactive Power BI reports, you will prepare data, model relationships, calculate revenue and pipeline KPIs, and interpret trends through filters and drill-through. The course also covers forecast views, metric documentation, dashboard-backed sales action plans, and introductory approaches to AI-assisted visuals and deployment governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with sales records, revenue metrics, customer activity, and commercial reporting. It suits learners who need practical Power BI capability without becoming software developers.
prerequisites: Prior experience with sales reporting, CRM records, spreadsheets, or revenue operations is useful but not mandatory. You need basic numerical literacy and familiarity with common sales terms such as opportunity, pipeline, quota, win rate, and revenue. No programming experience is required. The course teaches DAX and Power Query at practical foundation to intermediate depth, while advanced predictive modeling and enterprise deployment remain conceptual.
